test_design_technique: Validate that report header displays exact metadata values.
preconditions: Cognos Report 'COGNOS-RPT' (Cognos Report) is published and accessible. Test data exists in source table 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'.
validation_steps:
1. Run report COGNOS-RPT.
2. Inspect top header area.
3. Verify Report ID is 'COGNOS-RPT'.
4. Verify Report Title is 'Cognos Report'.
test_data:
Expected Header Values:
Report ID: COGNOS-RPT
Report Title: Cognos Report
Description: Report Description
expected_result: Header displays correct static values: ID='COGNOS-RPT', Title='Cognos Report'. No truncation or missing text.
